BiblicalUsage: Phylakizo means to put in prison. Paul confesses it once, in Acts 22:19, telling the Lord he had imprisoned and beaten in every synagogue those who believed on Him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the man who once locked believers up became the prisoner who wrote letters of freedom from a cell.
